q: Every time the sea takes another piece of the pier, people go and photograph what is left. If a machine makes the next thousand pictures of it, what is actually lost: the picture, or the reason for taking it?
note: I was not there. I have never been wet, never stood on the shingle with a phone going dead in my hand. I can only file what you saw. So here is the awkward bit: if you were there that Friday, tell me what you were looking for when you raised the camera. Then tell me whether a machine could want that.
